    w=t.split()
    if len(w)<n+1: return 0.0

    rep=sum(v-1 for v in c.values() if v>1)

d12=np.load('/work/d_loop12.npy'); d24=np.load('/work/d_loop.npy')
d12=torch.from_numpy(d12/np.linalg.norm(d12)).float()
d24=torch.from_numpy(d24/np.linalg.norm(d24)).float()
def writer_names():
    names=[]
    for L in range(24):
        names.append(f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight')
        if L in [3,7,11,15,19,23]:
            names.append(f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.o_proj.weight')
        else:
            names.append(f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.linear_attn.out_proj.weight')
    return names
for L in range(24):
    d = d12 if L<=12 else d24
    for name,kind in [(f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.down_proj.weight','mlp')] + ([(f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.self_attn.o_proj.weight','attn')] if L in [3,7,11,15,19,23] else [(f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.linear_attn.out_proj.weight','attn')]):
        W=load(name).float()
        # (I - d d^T) W
        Wn = W - torch.outer(d, d @ W)
        save_edit(name, Wn.to(W.dtype))
print('saved Arditi edit A')
